name: container_sync_secret
about: A container-sync set with a secret on code that supports one, every node on that code. The consumer on r1w-02 and the provider on r1w-01 are both created through the Deeploy API with the secret of set s1 as ENV.R1EN_SYNC_SECRET and the top-level secret_paths. The provider publishes twice, 90 s apart. The sync check passes when every publish reached the consumer within 150 s, nothing was refused, the files are equal, and the latest record on the oracles carries the format tag r1fs-set-v1 with a 64-hex mac. The custody check of each job reads its stored copy from R1FS with the default key (only the dAuth placeholder at the variable, the secret nowhere) and the app's count of the variable's bytes (0: the code hides the secret from the set's containers). Last, every node is searched for the secret in any form. Needs init --docker-nodes r1w-01,r1w-02 and the image redis:7-alpine on this machine.
